items.statement: Decontamination methods (cleaning, bio-decontamination and, where applicable, inactivation of biological materials) are appropriately defined and controlled.

items.statement: Evidence is available showing that the cleaning and bio-decontamination agents used have no adverse impact on the product made in the RABS or isolator.

items.statement: For isolators, interior bio-decontamination is automated, validated, controlled within defined cycle parameters and includes a sporicidal agent in a suitable form (e.g. gas or vapour).

items.statement: For isolators, gloves are suitably extended with fingers held apart during bio-decontamination so the agent reaches all surfaces.
items.quote: Gloves should be appropriately extended with fingers separated to ensure contact with the agent.

items.statement: For isolators, the cleaning and sporicidal bio-decontamination methods leave the interior surfaces and critical zone free of viable microorganisms.
items.quote: Methods used (cleaning and sporicidal bio-decontamination) should render the interior surfaces and critical zone of the isolator free from viable microorganisms.

items.statement: For RABS, sporicidal disinfection includes routine application of a sporicidal agent by a validated method shown to reliably reach all interior surfaces and to give a suitable environment for aseptic processing.
items.quote: The sporicidal disinfection should include the routine application of a sporicidal agent using a method that has been validated and demonstrated to robustly include all areas of the interior surfaces and ensure a suitable environment for aseptic processing.
